name: Hyatt Regency Kuala Lumpur at KL Midtown
short_description: A 406-key Hyatt Regency opposite MITEC in KL Midtown, Mont Kiara, with a Regency Club Lounge, two pools, and a pillarless grand ballroom.
ai_summary: Hyatt Regency Kuala Lumpur at KL Midtown opened in the Mont Kiara precinct opposite MITEC, Southeast Asia's largest convention centre, with 306 guest rooms plus 100 serviced residences designed by architect Kengo Kuma. Guests praise the spacious, spotlessly clean rooms, a generous Regency Club with full breakfast service, and an excellent breakfast buffet with wide variety. The main trade-off is location: it's a highway-accessible business and convention district rather than a walkable tourist area, so it suits convention-goers and value-focused Hyatt loyalists more than leisure travelers chasing nearby attractions.

faqs.question: Is Hyatt Regency Kuala Lumpur at KL Midtown walkable to attractions?
faqs.answer: No -- it's in the Mont Kiara/KL Midtown business and convention district opposite MITEC, with good highway access but few walkable tourist attractions nearby. It suits convention-goers and business travelers better than leisure visitors wanting a central, walkable base.

faqs.question: Does Hyatt Regency Kuala Lumpur at KL Midtown have a club lounge?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the Regency Club offers a generous full breakfast service, which reviewers call a highlight, alongside the hotel's separately well-regarded breakfast buffet with wide variety and consistently top-quality food.
